item.title: Serum Institute Internship Report: Vaccine Development, Recombinant Labs, and Clinical Trials
item.author: paws.simran@gmail.com
item.description:
At the Serum Institute of India, I gained a front-row seat to vaccine development and pharmaceutical quality control. This report outlines my immersive experience across R&D, clinical trials, and analytical labs—highlighting the rigorous processes behind public health innovations like the Covishield vaccine.

Read it here.

item.title: MyLab Internship Report: Diagnostics, PCR and More
item.author: paws.simran@gmail.com
item.description:
My reflections on a summer internship at MyLab Discovery Solutions, where I explored the science behind disease detection, particularly PCR and molecular diagnostics. From SOPs to RNA extraction, this report blends technical precision with personal growth in a hands-on research environment.

Read it here.
